"''Keep this Star Destroyer safe. The Rebels can't learn about Operation: Cinder.|Agent Gideon Hask and Commander Iden Versio|audio=VersioHask-Orders-BFII.flac|}} The '''attack on Fondor''' was a [[Space warfare|battle]] that took place between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire]] at one of the [[Fondor Shipyards]]' [[Fondor Station|stations]] over the [[Planet|world]] [[Fondor]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY]]. Just before the conflict erupted, [[Moff]] [[Derrek Raythe]]'s [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)|''Dauntless'']] prepared to depart the [[Imperial dockyard]] with [[Climate disruption array|experimental satellites]] meant for [[Operation: Cinder]] in tow while the [[Imperial Special Forces|special]] [[commando]] unit [[Inferno Squad]] oversaw its protection, but a rebel [[fleet]] at that point attacked Fondor Station. The [[Unidentified MC80 Star Cruiser|MC80 Star Cruiser]] within the fleet disabled the ''Dauntless'' with its [[ion cannon]]s, leaving the [[Star Destroyer]] defenseless. To prevent the rebels from learning about the [[satellite]]s' true purpose, Inferno Squad and several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] were deployed to engage the rebel [[Starship|ships]]. Inferno Squad defended the ''Dauntless'' from [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-wing transports]] attempting to board the Star Destroyer. The leader of Inferno Squad, [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]], then infiltrated the rebel [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|Star Cruiser's]] weapons bay and sabotaged its ion [[cannon]]s with the assistance of [[Agent]] [[Gideon Hask]]. Upon leaving the [[MC80 Star Cruiser|Star Cruiser]], Versio continued to defend the ''Dauntless'' and freed it by destroying the docking clamps holding the ship in place. The battle ended in an Imperial victory when the ''Dauntless'' crippled the [[MC-series star cruiser|Star Cruiser]] with its [[turbolaser]]s and departed Fondor Station with the satellites intact, where they would be deployed over Versio's [[homeworld]] of [[Vardos]]. ==Prelude== {{Quote|In preparation for Operation: Cinder, we've been ordered to the Fondor Shipyards. Agent Hask, you and I will retrieve experimental satellites for the Star Destroyer ''Dauntless'', and oversee security for Moff Raythe. Agent Meeko, you have the ''Corvus''.|Commander Versio, to Inferno Squad|audio=InfernoSquad-FondorBriefing-BFII.flac|}} During the [[Galactic Civil War]] in [[4 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire]] suffered a crushing [[Battle of Endor|defeat]] over the [[moon]] of [[Endor]] at the hands of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] when the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] [[superweapon]] was destroyed and the [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], [[Darth Sidious]], was [[Death|killed]]. On the orders of [[Vice Admiral]] [[Rae Sloane]], the surviving [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] retreated from the [[Endor system]]. [[Admiral]] [[Garrick Versio]] relayed the orders to [[Inferno Squad]]—a [[Imperial Special Forces|special]] [[commando]] unit that was stationed on Endor when the [[Death Star]] was destroyed. [[Commanding officer|Led]] by the admiral's [[Reproduction|daughter]], [[Commander]] [[Iden Versio]], Inferno Squad fought through [[Alliance Military|rebel forces]] and fled the moon in [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]]. [[File:FondorStation-BFII.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Corvus'' approaches Fondor Station.]] Iden was personally ordered by Garrick to meet him aboard his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Eviscerator]]'', which traveled to the [[planet]] [[Vardos]], their [[homeworld]]. Garrick informed her of the Emperor's death and showed her a message from a [[Sentinel (Contingency)|sentinel]] [[droid]] detailing [[Operation: Cinder]]—a plan to decimate several worlds using [[Climate disruption array|experimental satellites]] to impact their surfaces with extreme weather. Iden and Inferno Squad were tasked with retrieving the [[satellite]]s for the ''Imperial II''-class [[Star Destroyer]] [[Dauntless (Imperial-class)|''Dauntless'']] that had been stocked for [[Standard year|years]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Emperor Palpatine}} at the [[Fondor Shipyards|shipyards]] over the Imperial world of{{Databank|fondor|Fondor}} [[Fondor]]. Iden then relayed the mission to fellow Inferno Squad members [[Gideon Hask]] and [[Del Meeko]] aboard the team's [[Raider II-class corvette|''Raider II''-class corvette]],{{Databank|corvus-ship|Corvus (ship)}} [[Corvus (Raider II-class)|''Corvus'']]. Hask and Iden were to establish security for [[Moff]] [[Derrek Raythe]], the ''Dauntless''{{'}} commander, and gather the satellites for the Star Destroyer, while Meeko remained aboard the ''Corvus''. Inferno Squad traveled to [[Fondor Station]], where the ''Dauntless'' was docked, and successfully secured the satellites, allowing Operation: Cinder to begin as planned. ==The battle== {{GameMechanics}} ===Attack on the ''Dauntless''=== {{Quote|Attention, attention. Rebel ships have entered Fondor space.|An Imperial announces the rebel attack on Fondor|audio=FondorAlert-BFII.flac|}} [[File:Fondor_shipyard_attack.png|thumb|right|300px|The ''Dauntless'' is disabled by the rebel Star Cruiser.]] Before the ''Dauntless'' could depart the [[Imperial dockyard]], a [[fleet]] of Rebel Alliance forces exited [[hyperspace]] and began attacking Fondor Station. The fleet consisted of an [[Unidentified MC80 Star Cruiser|MC80 Star Cruiser]] escorted by multiple [[CR90 corvette]]s, [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|X-wing starfighters]], [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor|A-wing starfighters]], and [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft|U-wing transports]]. The [[MC80 Liberty Type Heavy Star Cruiser|Star Cruiser]] fired its [[ion cannon]]s at the ''Dauntless'', which was still docked at the [[Space station|station]], and disabled it. In order to prevent the rebels from learning about Operation: Cinder, Hask, Versio, and several other [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|pilots]] manned their [[TIE series|TIE fighters]] aboard the Star Destroyer and exited the [[Starship|vessel]] to engage the rebel forces, supported by [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s. Versio and Hask immediately [[Space warfare|attacked]] one of the [[corvette]]s and destroyed it, while Meeko dealt with other rebel ships aboard the ''Corvus''. With the ''Dauntless'' disabled, the rebels attempted to board the vessel with the U-wings but were thwarted when Inferno Squad shot down all of those [[transport]]s. As the battle progressed, Versio suggested to Raythe that the ''Dauntless'' flee the area with the satellites once the Star Destroyer's systems came back online, but the Moff refused, likening it to cowardice. Two [[X-wing starfighter|X-wings]] and one [[A-wing starfighter|A-wing]] began tailing Hask's TIE [[Starfighter|fighter]], although Versio destroyed them using her own [[Iden Versio's TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] after following them throughout the station. She then entered the [[MC80 Star Cruiser]]'s [[hangar]] while Hask defended the ''Dauntless'' on the commander's orders. Inside the rebel [[MC-series star cruiser|ship]], Versio opened fire on the hangar, destroying multiple ships and killing numerous [[Rebel trooper|rebel soldiers]]. Once the hangar was clear, Versio landed her TIE and began infiltrating the [[Star Cruiser]] to sabotage it while the rebels attempted to defend the ship. As the Star Cruiser continued to hammer the ''Dauntless'' with ion [[cannon]] fire, Hask entered the former ship on Versio's orders and regrouped with her in its weapons bay. When Versio's [[Dio|ID10 seeker droid]] [[Slicer|sliced]] into the ship's systems, rebel [[soldier]]s attempted to eliminate the two commandos but were unsuccessful. ===Imperial victory=== {{Quote|Now more than ever, power is the only path to peace. Admiral Versio will cleanse the galaxy, Commander. To remind them who is truly in control.|Moff Raythe, to Commander Versio|audio=Raythe-Peace-BFII.flac|}} [[File:Dauntless-Freed.png|thumb|left|300px|The ''Dauntless'' crippled the Star Cruiser after being released from the station.]] The [[ID10 seeker droid|droid's]] slicing exposed the ship's ion cannon's cooling cells. Versio destroyed the first two cells before planting an explosive on the final cell. The resulting explosion jettisoned it into [[Realspace|space]], where the cell collided with a nearby CR90 corvette and caused it to crash into the Star Cruiser, knocking Versio and Hask off-balance. The droid quickly activated the ship's [[Deflector shield|shields]] before Versio could be sucked into space. With the ship's ion cannons successfully disabled, the two commandos returned to their TIE fighters and exited the Star Cruiser. Moff Raythe then ordered Versio to destroy the power sources of the docking clamps on the station in order to free the trapped Star Destroyer. Versio pointed out that her orders were to protect the satellites and not to attack an Imperial station, to which Raythe responded by issuing her new orders to both protect them and attack the station. She thus destroyed Fondor Station's control tower and the docking arm holding the ''Dauntless'' in place before multiple rebel X-wings attempted to attack the ''Dauntless''. Versio suggested that the Empire could learn about the rebels if the Star Cruiser was disabled, but Hask stated that attempting to adopt the rebels' weakness would only result in failure. Subsequently, after the rebel fighters were shot down, Versio destroyed the clamps and freed the ship. The ''Dauntless'' then moved into an attack position and fired at the Star Cruiser with its heavy [[turbolaser]]s, severely damaging the rebel ship. {{EndGame}} ==Aftermath== {{Dialogue|Meeko|That's the ''Dauntless'', the ship we rescued on Fondor. Why's it here?|Hask|Well, it's delivering cargo. It was carrying those satellites. Moff Raythe said they were needed for Operation: Cinder, but he wouldn't tell us the target.|Versio|Neither would the Admiral. Now I know why.|attr=Del Meeko, Gideon Hask, and Iden Versio discuss the ''Dauntless''{{'}} presence over Vardos|audio=MeekoHaskVersio-Dauntless-BFII.flac|src=}} With the attack on Fondor thwarted, the ''Dauntless'' departed Fondor Station with the satellites and traveled to Vardos, where they would eventually be deployed. The assault on the [[shipyard]], however, resulted in [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruisers]] becoming a rarer sight, a fact that was later brought up by Imperial defector [[Ralsius Paldora]] upon seeing one of the [[Light cruiser|cruisers]] in action during his [[Skirmish on Takodana|extraction]] from the world{{Databank|takodana|Takodana}} [[Takodana]] in [[5 ABY]].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' states that the [[skirmish on Takodana]] took place 29 [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]], thus placing the event in [[5 ABY]]. After Hask and Versio returned from battle to the ''Corvus'', the commander briefed Inferno Squad on the status of the satellites and their next mission; Meeko was tasked with [[Mission to Pillio|destroying]] the [[Emperor's Observatory]] on the planet [[Pillio]] to prevent the Rebel Alliance from utilizing the artifacts stored within against the Empire. [[File:OperationCinder.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The satellites that Inferno Squad helped recover were deployed over Vardos.]] Following Meeko's mission, the ''Corvus'' traveled to Vardos, where Versio learned of the satellites' true purpose after seeing the ''Dauntless'' and the satellites positioned above the planet. Aboard the ''Eviscerator'', the commander confronted her [[Parent|father]] regarding the decision to attack their home, but was forced to watch as the satellites were activated over the planet. Inferno Squad was then ordered to [[Skirmish on Vardos|extract]] an Imperial, [[Protectorate (title)|Protectorate]] [[Gleb]], from the planet's [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Kestro City|Kestro]]. During the mission, Meeko and Versio deserted the Empire and escaped Vardos aboard the ''Corvus'', where they were eventually found by the Rebel Alliance and recruited into their ranks. Around 5 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]],"[[The Ghost Ship]]" takes place shortly before the [[Battle of Jakku]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' places in [[5 ABY]]. Therefore, the story must take place around that [[Standard year|year]]. the [[New Republic]],{{StoryCite|story=The Ghost Ship|book=Star Wars Adventures: Destroyer Down}} successor to the Rebel Alliance,''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' [[Battle of Fondor Shipyards|attacked]] the Fondor Shipyards with the aim of destroying the [[Interdictor-class heavy cruiser|''Interdictor''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Spectral]]''. The ship had its complement of TIE fighters deployed before escaping the shipyards by jumping to hyperspace. ==Behind the scenes== ===Appearance=== The attack on Fondor served as the focus of the third level, titled "The ''Dauntless''," of the [[DICE]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'', released on [[November 17]], [[2017]]. Prior to the game's release, footage of the battle was first shown in a gameplay trailer released on [[June 10]], 2017.{{EASWYouTube|_q51LZ2HpbE|Star Wars Battlefront II: Official Gameplay Trailer|sw_url=video/star-wars-battlefront-ii-official-gameplay-trailer}} The conflict was named in "[[Emperor Palpatine (reference book)|Emperor Palpatine]]," an issue of the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series published by [[De Agostini]] on [[May 25]], [[2021]].{{DeAgostini|url=libros-comics/enciclopedia-star-wars|text=Star Wars Encyclopedia}} In the seventh level of ''Battlefront II'', titled "General Distress," Ralsius Paldora mentions a shipyard assault that took place "a year back." Writer [[Mitch Dyer]] clarified that Paldora was in fact referencing the battle depicted in "The ''Dauntless''."{{Twitter|MitchyD|status/1410668527217004546|[[Mitch Dyer]]|quote=Yes! This was exactly the intent. Amazing you noticed. :D}} {{C|In response to: "Hey, @waltdwilliams, quick question! In the Takodana mission of Battlefront II, Paldora mentions a 'shipyard assault a year back' as the reason Arquitens cruisers aren't seen as much anymore. Is this a reference to the Fondor level earlier in the game, or something else? Thanks!"}} ===Mission objectives=== The first objective of the mission requires the player to destroy a CR90 corvette, but the ship can be avoided completely and will eventually be destroyed by friendly [[Wikipedia:Artificial intelligence in video games|AI]]. The next objective requires the player to destroy three U-wing transports, which in-game dialogue states would board the ''Dauntless'' if not destroyed quickly. However, there is no time limit for the objective as the U-wings never attempt to board the ship. Later on in the mission, if the player fails to destroy the two X-wing starfighters pursuing Gideon Hask, the enemy ships will instead crash into the station while the A-wing starfighter joins the pursuit immediately after. If the A-wing is not destroyed by the player after a certain amount of time, it will abandon chasing Hask and turn its sights on the player instead. The mission also features two collectibles, both of which are located aboard the rebel cruiser. They are stored within containers that require ID10 to slice them in order to unlock them. Finding both collectibles completes a milestone that yields a reward of twenty-five crafting parts. ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of attack on Fondor}} *''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]'' {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{EASWYouTube|_q51LZ2HpbE|Star Wars Battlefront II: Official Gameplay Trailer|sw_url=video/star-wars-battlefront-ii-official-gameplay-trailer}} {{1stp}} *{{EASWYouTube|pryBP4K-_34|Star Wars Battlefront II: Behind The Story}} *{{EASWYouTube|FNUTWw17rkM|Star Wars Battlefront II Single Player Trailer|sw_url=video/star-wars-battlefront-2-single-player-trailer}} *{{InsiderCite|177|Fist of the Empire (article)|reprint=1}} *{{BuildXWingCite|61|Creating a Starship Fleet}} *{{BuildXWingCite|74|Starfighter Aces}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Emperor Palpatine}} {{1stID|attack on Fondor}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{CanonGCW}} {{Interlang |de=Schlacht von Fondor (Galaktischer Bürgerkrieg) |fr=Bataille de Fondor |ja=フォンドア攻撃 |pl=Bitwa o Fondor (galaktyczna wojna domowa) |deGA=1 }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Fondor, attack on}} [[Category:Battles of Fondor]] [[Category:Battles of Operation: Cinder]]
